interpretations: For each invoice, show its invoice number, the average of `derived_total_cost / derived_product_cost` across its line items, and its line item count; return the 10 invoices with the highest line item counts in descending order.
queries:
SELECT
    i.invoice_number,
    AVG(CAST(ili.derived_total_cost AS REAL) / NULLIF(ili.derived_product_cost, 0)),
    COUNT(ili.invoice_number)
FROM Invoices AS i
LEFT JOIN Invoice_Line_Items AS ili
    ON ili.invoice_number = i.invoice_number
GROUP BY i.invoice_number
ORDER BY COUNT(ili.invoice_number) DESC
LIMIT 10;
